Declares nothing: the branch guarantees the deficit and a traded route (CENSUS-3d's food: ≤ deficit was a wrong presumption, 63 of 82 refused).

rows.notes: key: route river (guaranteed); declared because the key is the ROUTE, not the water home

rows.notes: key: route port AND terrain coastal (guaranteed)

rows.text: Bandits are taking the food caravans, and the settlement has posted a bounty for clearing the trade road...
Something is killing the forest the timber comes from, and the settlement's building and shipbuilding trade...
rows.notes: "shipbuilding trades": presumes boats can be built and floated (the reader:hook-pools [sea] class on plains/desert roads). A shipyard is no institution kind (docks matches docks/harbour/wharf/quay/port), so the water home answers. TWIN OWED: the same sentence without "and shipbuilding" (excludes: water: navigable) — the chair's ruling, recorded in the lane doc
